summary: Verified professional share-links flow, parent invite link, tagline, and regressions. Found+fixed one CRITICAL bug: backend supervisor config injects a stale APP_URL that overrides backend/.env, so all generated /join/ links pointed to an unreachable subdomain (5dd2bfb0-... preview) instead of align-report.preview.emergentagent.com. Applied one-line fix in backend/server.py (load_dotenv(override=True)) and re-verified end-to-end. All targeted flows now work.

minor.issue: Admin login returns 401 in test_hub_features::test_admin_has_sections_and_totals — known transient lockout / password mismatch (per review note); not chased.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Dashboard.jsx line ~231 renders professional name inside a wrapping <span> under <option>, which is invalid HTML and triggers hydration mismatch warnings.

action_items: Confirm/keep the load_dotenv(override=True) change in /app/backend/server.py so backend/.env APP_URL always wins over supervisor's stale env var; otherwise /join/ share-links break for real users.
Fix Dashboard.jsx professional-select option: render professional name as plain text child of <option> (no nested <span>) to remove the React hydration warning.
Admin login lockout in test_hub_features is transient — main agent can ignore for now (review noted this).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py used load_dotenv() with default override=False. In a supervisor-managed environment where APP_URL was baked into supervisord.conf, this silently masked the correct value from backend/.env — producing valid-looking but unreachable share links. Fix: load_dotenv(override=True). This pattern (load_dotenv timing/override) is exactly what the auth-testing playbook flags.
The frontend /join/<token> page shows a generic 'Network Error' card when the API request fails, but 'This invitation is no longer valid' for known-invalid tokens — good UX distinction; keep it.
test_credentials: Pro/parent accounts registered dynamically via /api/auth/register with @testmail.dev emails (unique per run). Admin creds not used per review guidance.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral pro + 2 parent invitees + joint report per test run; no persistent seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Share-link tests now green end-to-end. The env-level bug (supervisor sets stale APP_URL overriding .env) is fixed via load_dotenv(override=True). If backend is rebuilt/redeployed and APP_URL differs, re-verify pro-link-text-a/b domain matches REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Minor Dashboard <option> hydration warning still open. Field mapping in JointNew invite step: parent uses (co-parent-name-input, co-parent-email-input); professional uses BOTH (parent-a-invite-name-input, parent-a-invite-email-input) AND (co-parent-name-input, co-parent-email-input) for parents A and B respectively. Submit btn is send-invitation-btn (singular).
rca of the issue: Root cause: /etc/supervisor/conf.d/supervisord.conf hardcodes environment=APP_URL="https://5dd2bfb0-...preview.emergentagent.com" (a previous pod's URL). Python's dotenv.load_dotenv() defaults to override=False, so os.environ['APP_URL'] retained the supervisor value even after backend/.env was updated to the correct https://align-report.preview.emergentagent.com. All share-link generation (server.py app_url()) therefore emitted links to a dead domain. Reproduction: (1) POST /api/joint/reports/professional -> response.invitations[*].link contained the stale host; (2) opening the link showed 'Network Error'. Mitigation applied: change load_dotenv() -> load_dotenv(override=True) in server.py line 3, sudo supervisorctl restart backend. Post-fix: links contain align-report.preview.emergentagent.com and /join/<token> renders the invitation card correctly.
